# export

Export data from Dataverse to a ZIP file

## Usage

```
ppds data export [options]
```

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--batch-size` |  | `int` |  | Records per API request (all records are exported; this controls request size) |
| `--debug` |  | `bool` |  | Enable diagnostic logging output |
| `--environment` | `-env` | `string` |  | Override the environment URL. Takes precedence over profile's bound environment. |
| `--format` |  | `ExportDataFormat` |  | Data export format: cmt (CMT-compatible XML ZIP) or json (PPDS-native JSON) |
| `--output` | `-o` | `FileInfo` |  | Output ZIP file path |
| `--output-format` | `-f` | `OutputFormat` |  | Output format |
| `--page-parallel` |  | `int` |  | Partitions per entity for page-level parallelism (0=auto, 1=disabled) |
| `--page-parallel-threshold` |  | `int` |  | Minimum records before page-level parallelism activates |
| `--parallel` |  | `int` |  | Maximum concurrent entity exports (only applies when schema contains multiple entities) |
| `--profile` | `-p` | `string` |  | Profile name(s). For high-throughput pooling, specify multiple Application User profiles comma-separated (e.g., app1,app2,app3) - each profile multiplies API quota. |
| `--schema` | `-s` | `FileInfo` |  | Path to schema.xml file |
| `--verbose` | `-v` | `bool` |  | Enable verbose logging output |
